title:
Listens to 'STEP_INDEX_UPDATE' and 'FORM_SUBMIT' on 'Reliability.EditCaseMultiStepForm'.
When we edit case in All Cases component, this epic
validates that facility, name, priority, assignee required fields in all the nested forms are filled.
- If it's not valid, opens 'Reliability.ModalBanner', informing user to fill all the required fields.
name: ValidateEditCaseFormFieldsEpic
